title: 20-seed robustness extension for latent operator induction
question: Is the C19 latent-operator selection behavior robust across a larger pre-specified seed panel, and what is the observed operator-confusion pattern?
relation_to_prior: Post-C19 robustness extension. It cannot replace, upgrade, or rewrite the original five-seed C19 decision.
rules: No change to the C19 contract, outcome, or threshold is permitted from this extension.
The frozen C19 benchmark generator blob must match before training.
Held-out compositions remain exactly the C19 12-composition set.
Evaluation is generated after training from the registered per-seed evaluation RNG namespace.
Training/evaluation semantic overlap must be zero.
Operator confusion is computed from argmax operator prediction before oracle override.
Training operator counts are recorded from the actual sampled combo2 stream.
No hyperparameter, checkpoint, seed, or metric selection is permitted.
Results are descriptive robustness evidence only and cannot overturn C19.
decision_rule: Estimate robustness of the C19 operator-selection behavior across 20 seeds.
Report the full truth-operator by predicted-operator confusion matrix.
Report per-operator q2 and operator-selection accuracy with 150 evaluation episodes per operator per seed.
Treat XNOR/XOR symmetry-breaking as a conjecture unless the larger panel supports it.
hypothesis: The larger seed panel will quantify whether C19's observed operator-selection instability is recurrent and identify any operator-specific confusion pattern without changing the original C19 decision.

arms.name: normal_latent_operator_020seed
arms.intervention: same latent-operator model and training protocol as C19, repeated for the 20 registered seeds

arms.name: oracle_operator_diagnostic
arms.intervention: same trained model with hidden operator supplied only for q2 diagnostic scoring
